name: Takeda
description: Takeda is a Tokyo-based drugmaker selling medicines for gastrointestinal, rare, neurological and cancer conditions plus plasma-derived therapies to health systems in about 80 countries, with roughly 49,000 employees.

name: International Finance Corpor
description: The World Bank Group's private-sector arm, IFC provides loans, equity, trade finance and advice to companies in more than 100 developing countries, committing $71.7 billion in fiscal 2025.

name: Deutsche Bank
description: Deutsche Bank is a Frankfurt-based bank offering corporate, investment, private and retail banking and asset management to companies, institutions and individuals, with about 85,000 employees in 58 countries.

name: Alianza
description: Utah-based Alianza sells a cloud communications platform that lets telecom carriers and cable operators offer voice, messaging and collaboration services, deployed at more than 100 service providers.

name: Kapital
description: Kapital is a Mexico City-based, AI-driven bank serving small and mid-sized businesses in Mexico, Colombia and the US, valued at about $1.3 billion after a 2025 funding round.
note: Acquired Intercam Banco (2025), which faced US FinCEN anti-money-laundering action.

name: NineDot Energy
description: NineDot Energy develops and operates community-scale battery storage sites in New York City and Long Island that support the local grid, with $431 million raised in 2026 for 28 projects.

name: Commonwealth Fusion Syste
description: Commonwealth Fusion Systems is building the SPARC fusion demonstration machine in Massachusetts and plans a 400 MW commercial ARC plant in Virginia, with Google and Eni signed as power buyers.

name: Manulife Financial
description: Manulife, branded John Hancock in the US, sells insurance, wealth and asset management products to individuals and institutions across Asia, Canada and the US; listed in Toronto and New York.

name: Comeast
description: Comcast sells broadband, mobile, TV and voice services under the Xfinity brand to US homes and businesses and owns NBCUniversal and Sky, employing roughly 186,000 people.

name: Tabby
description: Tabby is a Riyadh-based buy now, pay later app letting shoppers split payments at over 40,000 brands across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, with more than 15 million users.

name: Figure
description: Figure Technology Solutions runs a blockchain lending platform that originates home equity lines of credit for US homeowners and partner lenders, facilitating over $16 billion; listed on Nasdaq since 2025.

name: SmartStop Self Storage
description: SmartStop Self Storage is a real estate investment trust owning and managing self-storage facilities rented by households and businesses across the US and Canada; listed on the NYSE since 2025.

name: Avalanche
description: Avalanche is a public layer-1 blockchain network, developed by New York-based Ava Labs, that lets developers, enterprises and financial institutions launch their own blockchains, with about 80 live chains.

name: Bank Muscat
description: Bank Muscat is Oman's largest bank by assets, offering retail, corporate and Islamic banking to individuals and businesses, with 3.9 million customers and about 198 branches in Oman.

name: DANONE
description: Danone makes and sells dairy and plant-based foods, bottled waters such as Evian and specialized nutrition such as Aptamil to consumers and healthcare channels in over 120 countries.

name: Serve
description: Serve Robotics builds AI-powered sidewalk delivery robots that carry orders for Uber Eats and 7-Eleven in US cities including Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas and Chicago; listed on Nasdaq.
